description: This file defines the Zend_Http_UserAgent_Console class, which extends Zend_Http_UserAgent_Desktop. It provides methods for identifying a console user agent based on specific signatures and for returning the type of user agent as 'console'.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_Console
classes.description: A class to identify console user agents and provide their type information, extending the Desktop user agent class.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Checks if the user agent matches known console signatures.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the string 'console' indicating the user agent type.
